description: This source file defines the ExternalTypeGrain class, which implements the IExternalTypeGrain interface. The class is an Orleans grain that handles external types like collections and enums, providing methods to retrieve models involving such types and logging actions.

classes.name: ExternalTypeGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain class that provides methods to interact with external data types and enums, with logging support.

methods.name: GetAbstractModel
methods.description: Returns a completed task after logging a debug message; intended to retrieve a model based on external collection data.

methods.name: GetEnumModel
methods.description: Returns a task with an EnumClass instance, containing a list with DateTimeKind.Local as a sample enum data.
